description: MCB Bank Limited is one of Pakistan's oldest banks, incorporated in the private sector in 1947, nationalised in 1974 and privatised in 1991. Its major shareholding is owned by the Nishat Group, and it operates a domestic and international branch network supported by digital banking channels. MCB Islamic Bank Limited is a wholly owned Islamic banking subsidiary, and the bank also holds subsidiaries in investment management, non-bank credit and exchange services.
